hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 8 physical CPU cores, 16 GiB unified RAM
notes: Node/pnpm and lockfile information supplement the frozen source/model protocol.
Model timings use the native Metal runtime. No Docker or remote inference.
RSS sampling is not a measurement of total unified-memory pressure or exclusive GPU allocation.
Cold startup means process launch to health, with normal macOS filesystem caches. SHA verification before launch is excluded.
The deterministic baseline parity tests also run under the repository's Node 22 CI convention. Local measured parser timings use Node 24.21.0.

The 4B recorded wall span exceeds summed request timers substantially. The cause of the unmeasured gap was not verified; use request latency samples, not this wall span, for comparison. This was not a controlled continuous-throughput or thermal benchmark.
